author: Allen
name: OT Lab - Physical process: tank overflow
description: The field I/O simulator (process ground truth) reports an overflow. This is the 'impact' signal - correlate backwards to find the command that caused it.
query:
FROM logs-ot_process* METADATA _id, _index
| WHERE tank.overflow == true
| STATS events = COUNT(*), max_level = MAX(tank.level), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp) BY host.name
note: Work backwards: Timeline -> Zeek modbus writes to __NET__.40.10 in the 10 minutes before `first_seen`, then compare against `logs-ot_hmi_audit*`.
